mentions.name: MealDone
mentions.description: This meal planning app helps households decide what to cook, combining swipe-based meal picking (matches between household members become dinner picks), an in-store pick mode that instantly suggests three quality dinner options, an aisle-oriented shopping list, budget and personal taste preferences, and fridge inventory in one place. A work-in-progress AI mode targets recipe search and ingredient substitution (e.g. using up ingredients about to go bad) rather than recipe generation, and the UI is styled like a restaurant menu with off-white background, black text, and no glossy photos.
mentions.problem: The daily "what do you want for dinner" grind leads to rushed store trips, the same five fallback meals, half-used ingredients, and leftovers dying in the fridge, while recipe sites are hostile with ads that jump the page, many near-identical versions of each dish, and visual clutter; the author's newborn's milk protein allergy made finding safe recipes especially difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built what I wanted: swipe mode that makes picking dinner fun again, or instant 3 quality suggestions for when I am in the store. Aisle oriented shopping list, budget, personal taste, fridge inventory in one place.
